Minimizing risk is just the beginning. Our ultimate goal is to maximize potential. We do that by starting at the heart of any business: people. We help our clients provide comprehensive care to their employees while reducing costs and improving outcomes. Because when people are well, businesses thrive.

pages.raw_meta: CorVel's general liability claims solutions achieve superior savings, protect your brand, and minimize exposure.
raw_blocks: Protection that’s ready for anything.

From slip-and-fall claims to complex exposures, our liability solutions are backed by established expertise and smart technology. We act fast to resolve claims, protect your brand, and reduce costs — so you’re always ready for what’s next.
A personalized process, built to protect your business.
From urgent investigations to subrogation recovery, every step is handled with precision, care, and the experience to adapt through the unpredictable.
Fast starts, guided by expertise.
We respond within 24 hours, with a liability specialist who knows how to move quickly — and move smart.
Evidence gathered by experienced claims professionals
Industry-backed insights from day one
Focused on resolution from the start
Clear visibility in uncertain moments.
With Care🅪, you can track general liability claims in real-time—giving you clarity when you need it most.
Monitor progress and pinpoint areas of concern
Support that’s been there before.
We’ve handled litigation and subrogation across industries, helping our clients minimize risk and reclaim losses.
Proven litigation strategies shaped by experience
Recovery efforts led by liability experts
The numbers tell the story — and they point forward.

Our performance mindset is rooted in experience and proven by numbers. We focus on what matters, cycle times, closing ratios, and KPIs, to help every liability claim reach the best possible outcome, faster.
Faster claims resolutions driven by streamlined workflows and proactive case handling.
We guide liability claims to resolution with fewer delays and stronger accuracy.
Every decision is backed by real-time data to ensure liability claims close efficiently and effectively.
Smarter claims start with built-in insight.
Every feature is shaped by what we've learned, providing the tools needed to manage liability claims with clarity, speed, and confidence.
Learn more about Smarter claims start with built-in insight.
Let’s build what’s next, together.
